mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_UID AS userUid, U.ARCHIVE_NAME AS archiveName, F.URL_PATH AS profileImageUrlPath FROM `USER` U LEFT JOIN `FILE` F ON F.FILE_UID = U.PROFILE_IMAGE_UID WHERE U.FLAG_DELETED = 'N' AND U.USER_UID != #{userUid} AND LOCATE(#{query}, U.ARCHIVE_NAME) > 0 ORDER BY U.ARCHIVE_NAME, U.USER_UID LIMIT 20

SELECT U.USER_UID AS userUid, U.ARCHIVE_NAME AS archiveName, F.URL_PATH AS profileImageUrlPath FROM ARTICLE_VIEWER V JOIN `USER` U ON U.USER_UID = V.USER_UID AND U.FLAG_DELETED = 'N' LEFT JOIN `FILE` F ON F.FILE_UID = U.PROFILE_IMAGE_UID WHERE V.ARTICLE_UID = #{articleUid} ORDER BY U.ARCHIVE_NAME, U.USER_UID
